title: Nonvanishing of coordinate sections
statement: For a finite nonempty coordinate set n and scheme S, the nonvanishing locus [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] of T_i = twistOneSection in O(1) [def-pc-projective-space-twist] on projective space P over S [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] is D_+(T_i)_S, for every i in n.

source.place: Constructions, Lemma (Tag 01NG, label lemma-standard-covering-projective-space) for the charts of P^n_Z; Lemma (Tag 01MV, label lemma-principal-open) and Lemma (Tag 01MS, label lemma-when-invertible) for the non-vanishing locus of T_i and the generator of O(1) on D_+(T_i); Definition (Section Tag 01ND, label definition-projective-space) for the base change; with Schemes, Lemmas 01JR and 01I4 (literature/stacks-project/schemes.tex) for the restriction over Spec R

proof.text:
The pullback formula for the image of 1 identifies the global value of the
upstream morphism coordinateSection with twistOneSection. Naturality under restriction
then identifies coordinateSection with homOfGlobalSection of twistOneSection, since
maps from the structure module are determined by the image of 1. The proved theorem
nonvanishingLocus_eq_compl_support_zeroLocus identifies the stalk definition with the
complement of this morphism's zero-locus support. The upstream theorem
compl_support_zeroLocus_coordinateSection identifies that open with standardOpen.

proof_origin.place: Second reading Y3, 2026-10-13: reduction following Stacks 01NG/01MV, using proved upstream chart declarations and Mathlib adjunction uniqueness.

theorem projectiveSpace_standardCharts_part2 (n : Type u) (S : Scheme.{u})
    [Finite n] [Nonempty n] :
    (∀ i : n, Scheme.Modules.nonvanishingLocus (twist n S 1) (twistOneSection n S i) =
          (standardOpen n S i : Set ℙ(n; S)))
